description: An LFO with six outputs at fixed phases 60 degrees apart and a seventh output whose phase is set by hand. Every output carries the same wave

params.text: Multiplies the frequency by ten in the x 10 position
Scales the CV arriving at the FM input
The width of the pulse wave
Scales the CV modulating the pulse width
Chooses the wave that every output carries
Switches every output between UNI, swinging on one side of zero only, and BI, swinging either side of it
The phase of the free output, in degrees
Tap it in time and the LFO takes its frequency from the interval between the taps
Switches the wave selection between DISCRETE, which steps from one wave to the next, and MORPH, which blends between them
Scales the CV moving the wave selection
Restarts the LFO at the beginning of its cycle
Scales the CV modulating the free output's phase

inputs.text: A CV modulating the pulse width
A CV modulating the free output's phase
Pulses here set the LFO frequency from the interval between them
A CV moving the wave selection
A pulse restarts the LFO at the beginning of its cycle

outputs.text: The wave with no phase shift
The wave shifted by the number of degrees set for the free phase

notes: the frequency display takes typed text: a figure in Hz, or a tempo written as 120 bpm, 120 qpm for quarters, 120 epm for eighths or 120 spm for sixteenths per minute
menu: USE -10v to 10V BIPOLAR mode — widens the bipolar swing of every output to -10V to 10V
Set Output 1 to Poly 6 — turns the first output into a polyphonic output carrying all six fixed phases, one to a channel

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
